import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { diaryComments } from "../../../backend/schema/diary_comments";

// A board over "bodyFormat" fits this table, but a board needs a text column to keep each card's order in. Add one, then declare kanban: { columnField: "bodyFormat", orderField: "<that column>" }.
export const diaryCommentsCms = customizeTable<typeof diaryComments>("diary_comments", {
    icon: "MessageCircle",
    display: {
        title: "body"
    },
    listFields: ["id", "bodyFormat", "visible", "diaryEntry", "user", "body"],
    fields: {
        body: {
            multiline: true,
            markdown: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "id",
        "bodyFormat",
        "visible",
        "diaryEntry",
        "user",
        "body",
        "createdAt",
        "updatedAt"
    ]
});
